display_long_description:
# Bring a tiny industrial world to life with your own hands

Start with a handful of machines and grow them into a massive industrial empire that fills your room.

🪨 Mine and transport resources

🏭 Build production chains to create increasingly valuable products

🤖 Record loops with drones and industrial robots to create an automated workforce

📈 Expand, optimize, and scale your factory

🏠 Play in different VR environments, or mixed reality to transform your real room into an industrial playground

[media]

Every conveyor belt, machine, and robot you create brings your factory one step closer to total automation.

Sell products to earn money and research new materials, unlocking more advanced facilities and production lines. Grow from simple resource extraction to a sprawling automated operation capable of constructing an entire server tower, one floor at a time.

[media]

# Both Mixed Reality and VR support
Build on top of furniture, place virtual tables, or sit down and play in VR in this physics playground.

[media]

# Features

🎯 2h+ campaign mode

♾️ Freeplay and infinite sandbox mode

🏭20 facilities (and growing)

⏺️ 3 recordable items (drones, industrial robots)

💾 Extensive save system with multiple save slots

↔️ Scaling options to play in all kinds of rooms

🎮 Physics-driven gameplay - infinite solutions - very fun!

🕸️ Play how you like: Options such as grid mode or free placement

 ... + much more

**Experimental features:**

- Level Builder
- Weekly Challenges


**Build with 💜 by Jonas Sandstedt**
